changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names and simplified outputs. Removed redundant 'Multi-view BART' (same as Multi-view Sequence-to-Sequence Model) and simplified 'DynamicConv + GPT-2/News' to focus on the core model.
Normalized all ROUGE variants to the base 'ROUGE' metric following simplification guidelines.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper.

guideline: Rate summaries on a scale of -2 to 2 based on relevance, conciseness, and correctness

changes_made.explanation: Added 'correctness' which is implied by the rating scale description. Normalized criteria names for consistency.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on abstractive dialogue summarization using multi-view sequence-to-sequence models. It uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and model variants.
